A few things
worth knowing.

Early days. Thoughtful steps.
Here's what Maychant can do today.

What can I do here today?

Complete a free preparation check and download a plan for your next conversation. It works for owners, future operators, and advisers—without creating an account or uploading documents.

Can I buy or list a business here?

We're starting with preparation. There are no live business listings or buyer introductions on this site. Our ambition is to help more good businesses continue under capable ownership.

Do I need to be ready to sell?

No. Exploring what comes next can be useful years before a transition. The check helps you organize the questions and practical work worth thinking about now.

What happens to my answers?

Your preparation answers stay in this page's memory and are not submitted to Maychant. Refreshing the page clears them. You choose whether to download your plan. Contacting us separately opens your email app for you to review and send a message.

Is the plan a valuation or professional review?

No. It's a starting checklist based on your own answers. Your accountant, adviser, attorney, or lender can help you with the decisions that need their expertise.

How can I help shape Maychant?

We're learning from people planning real handovers. Tell us where you're getting stuck and what useful help would look like.
